items.headline: RBI expected to maintain key interest rate at 5.25% through 2026
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to keep its key interest rate at 5.25% for the remainder of 2026, assessing the impact of Middle East conflict and deeming rate hike discussions "premature" despite recent inflation uptick.

items.headline: India's June retail inflation breaches RBI target, hits 4.38%
items.summary: India's retail inflation reached 4.38% year-on-year in June, exceeding the central bank's 4% target for the first time in 17 months, mainly due to higher fuel and food costs. RBI projects CPI at 5.1% for FY27.

items.headline: Government to conduct ₹20,000 crore buyback of securities today
items.summary: The Indian government will execute a ₹20,000 crore buyback of government securities via an RBI-managed auction today, July 28, aimed at reducing repayment pressure and managing debt efficiently.

items.headline: India's industrial production data scheduled for release today
items.summary: Key industrial production data, a significant indicator of manufacturing and economic activity, is slated for release today, July 28.

items.headline: RBI Deputy Governor emphasizes wider access to bond markets for enterprises
items.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Rohit Jain highlighted the necessity to broaden bond market access for enterprises to secure market-based finance, noting the bank-led model's potential inadequacy for future financing needs.

items.headline: US Treasury keeps India off currency watch list, finds no rupee manipulation
items.summary: The US Treasury expanded its foreign exchange review but confirmed India did not manipulate the rupee for trade advantage, consequently keeping India off its currency watch list.

items.headline: Indian indices set for flat open amid negative Asian, US cues
items.summary: Indian benchmark indices are expected to open flat today, July 28, tracking predominantly negative cues from Asian markets and US stock futures, despite falling crude oil prices.

items.headline: Brent crude falls below $90, easing oil price concerns
items.summary: Crude oil prices have fallen, with Brent crude now trading below the $90 a barrel mark, contributing to some easing of global economic concerns.

items.headline: Indian markets snap losing streak with strong rebound on July 27
items.summary: Indian markets witnessed a strong rebound on Monday, July 27, with Nifty 50 gaining 0.96% and Sensex advancing 1.02%, ending a five-session losing streak due to easing US-Iran tensions and declining crude oil prices.

items.headline: FIIs net sellers, DIIs net buyers on July 27
items.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net sellers of ₹1,688.23 crore worth of shares on July 27, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net buyers of ₹2,329.14 crore.

items.headline: Tata Power reports 11% rise in Q1 net profit on renewables, generation boost
items.summary: Tata Power's net profit increased by 11% year-on-year in Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance in its renewables, transmission, and generation segments.

items.headline: BEL net profit up 8.7%, revenue jumps 25% in Q1
items.summary: Bharat Electronics reported an 8.7% rise in net profit and a 25% jump in revenue for the first quarter of FY27, indicating robust growth.

items.headline: Northern Arc Capital sees 17.6% net profit growth in Q1
items.summary: Northern Arc Capital's net profit rose by 17.6% and net interest income increased by 44.2% in Q1 FY27, showcasing strong financial performance.

items.headline: Usha Martin posts 40.7% net profit jump, 16.4% revenue growth in Q1
items.summary: Usha Martin achieved a 40.7% year-on-year increase in net profit and 16.4% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27.

items.headline: CCL Products India reports 61.3% YoY surge in Q1 consolidated net profit
items.summary: CCL Products India had a strong quarter, with consolidated net profit increasing by 61.3% year-on-year.

items.headline: Tata Chemicals reports Q1 net loss of ₹17 crore due to weak realizations
items.summary: Tata Chemicals posted a consolidated net loss of ₹17 crore for the June quarter, a decline from a profit of ₹252 crore in the previous year, attributed to weaker realizations and lower contributions from joint ventures.

items.headline: Godfrey Phillips India Q1 net profit down 44.3% YoY
items.summary: Godfrey Phillips India reported a 44.3% year-on-year decline in net profit and an 18.9% year-on-year fall in revenue for Q1 FY27, reflecting softer business conditions.

items.headline: Coal India Q1 net profit up marginally by 0.6%, below expectations
items.summary: Coal India's consolidated net profit saw a modest 0.6% increase in Q1 FY27, which was flat compared to some expectations, impacted by muted offtake and higher operating expenses.

items.headline: Larsen & Toubro, HUL, Ambuja Cements among companies announcing Q1 results today
items.summary: A large number of companies, including Larsen & Toubro, Hindustan Unilever, Ambuja Cements, Tata Capital, Suzlon Energy, Radico Khaitan, City Union Bank, Cholamandalam Investment, DCM Shriram, Equitas Small Finance Bank, Pfizer, Phoenix Mills, Pine Labs, Supreme Industries, Varun Beverages, and VST Industries, are scheduled to announce their Q1 FY27 results today, July 28.

items.headline: IT, Media, Realty, and Auto sectors lead market gains
items.summary: On July 27, the IT (+2.34%), Media (+2.39%), Realty (+2.28%), and Auto (+1.60%) sectors led the market gains, with IT stocks boosted by improved valuations and Jefferies upgrade, and Realty/Auto by lower crude oil prices.

items.headline: Oil & Gas Exploration sector experiences significant decline
items.summary: The Oil & Gas Exploration sector saw the most significant decline on July 27, falling 3.44%.

items.headline: Adani Energy Solutions launches QIP at ₹1,698.15 per share
items.summary: Adani Energy Solutions initiated its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) on July 27, with a floor price set at ₹1,698.15 per share.

items.headline: TVS Motor acquires additional 4.39% stake in TVS Credit Services
items.summary: TVS Motor Company increased its holding in TVS Credit Services to 85.15% by acquiring an additional 4.39% stake from Lucas TVS for ₹711 crore.

items.headline: Heritage Foods acquires additional 20% stake in PBJL, making it a subsidiary
items.summary: Heritage Foods acquired an additional 20% stake in PBJL, effective July 27, making it a subsidiary.

items.headline: BNP Paribas Cardif to acquire 26% stake in IndiaFirst Life Insurance
items.summary: BNP Paribas Cardif has agreed to acquire approximately a 26% stake in IndiaFirst Life Insurance Company from Warburg Pincus, pending regulatory approval.

items.headline: Mankind Pharma completes sale of Broadway Hospitality Services for ₹49 crore
items.summary: Mankind Pharma finalized the sale of its entire 100% stake in its subsidiary, Broadway Hospitality Services, for ₹49 crore.

items.headline: Gravita India board approves closure of Gravita Metal Inc. subsidiary
items.summary: Gravita India's board approved the closure of its subsidiary, Gravita Metal Inc., effective August 1, 2026, as part of operations consolidation efforts.

items.headline: Bank of Baroda reports cybersecurity incident, no material impact
items.summary: Bank of Baroda reported a cybersecurity incident involving a potential business email compromise, but confirmed no material impact on its operations.

items.headline: Torrent Pharmaceuticals gets approval for JB Chemicals amalgamation share listing
items.summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals received approval from NSE and BSE for the listing of over 4.19 crore shares issued under the JB Chemicals amalgamation, effective today.

items.headline: Tata Motors' Sanand plant faces flood disruption, expects normalcy soon
items.summary: Tata Motors' Sanand plant and its suppliers in Gujarat experienced disruption due to flooding but anticipate a swift return to normal operations.

items.headline: InterGlobe Aviation redesignates CFO, appoints new one
items.summary: InterGlobe Aviation has redesignated its Chief Financial Officer and appointed a new one, effective today, July 28.

items.headline: Meesho in focus over Elevation Capital's potential ₹1,200 crore share sale
items.summary: E-commerce platform Meesho is in focus amidst reports that Elevation Capital might sell shares worth ₹1,200 crore through a block deal.

items.headline: Kolte Patil Developers reappoints Girish Vanvari as Independent Director
items.summary: Kolte Patil Developers reappointed Girish Vanvari as an Independent Non-Executive Director for a second five-year term, effective July 29, 2026.

items.headline: Godrej Properties, Greaves Cotton, Dollar Industries among ex-dividend stocks today
items.summary: Several companies, including Godrej Properties, Greaves Cotton, Dollar Industries, EIH Associated Hotels, GMM Pfaudler, Solar Industries, and SRF, are trading ex-dividend today, July 28.

items.headline: HDFC Bank concludes MSRDC review, finds employees exceeded authority; executives fined
items.summary: HDFC Bank's internal review of the MSRDC deposit matter found employees exceeded authority without mala fide intent. Top executives were reportedly fined ₹1 lakh each by the board for diverging from RBI direction.

items.headline: Rajesh Exports denies information on reported NEFRA probe
items.summary: Rajesh Exports stated it has no information regarding a reported NEFRA (National Financial Reporting Authority) probe.

items.headline: Wipro partners with Databricks for enterprise data modernization and AI deployment
items.summary: Wipro has partnered with Databricks to assist enterprises in modernizing data infrastructure and implementing AI solutions at scale.

items.headline: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services signs 3-year agreement with Daimler India Commercial Vehicles
items.summary: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services entered a three-year agreement with Daimler India Commercial Vehicles to provide its Zaggle Zatix platform and Corporate Credit Card Programme.

items.headline: Sun Pharma partner Philogen resubmits Nidlegy marketing authorization for melanoma treatment
items.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries' partner Philogen has resubmitted a European Medicines Agency marketing authorization application for Nidlegy, a melanoma treatment.

items.headline: Jeena Sikho Lifecare launches four Ayurvedic pain relief patch products
items.summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare has launched four new Ayurvedic pain relief patch products.

items.headline: Pfizer India's Executive Director-Finance and CFO resigns
items.summary: Pfizer India's Executive Director-Finance and CFO has resigned, effective October 8, 2026.

items.headline: Avenue Supermarts opens new DMart store in Udaipur, total count now 505
items.summary: Avenue Supermarts (DMart) has opened a new store in Udaipur, bringing its total store count to 505.

items.headline: HCLTech releases Economist Enterprise AI research on TMT sector
items.summary: HCLTech has released Economist Enterprise AI research focusing on the Technology, Media, and Telecom (TMT) sector.

items.headline: Goodluck Defence receives Quality Assurance Certificate for artillery shells
items.summary: Goodluck India's subsidiary, Goodluck Defence, has been awarded a Quality Assurance Certificate for its artillery shells.
